mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduler_job_run_history WHERE started_at >= #{startedAt} ORDER BY started_at ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_job_run_history SET job_id = #{po.jobId}, started_at = #{po.startedAt}, ended_at = #{po.endedAt}, trigger_type = #{po.triggerType}, status = #{po.status}, error_message = #{po.errorMessage}, duration_seconds = #{po.durationSeconds}, remark = #{po.remark}, result_summary = CAST(#{po.resultSummary} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{po.id}
